items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: I play with Thomas... He used to play With Marshall He used to play with the brass band too Noonell Thomas

ctx.x: Well Kid Thomas is about 62 so you gotta have a good age
Yeah I gotta put a good age How old were you when Thomas was born? Oh I married when I was about 17 years old I married young
Oh I see and and so he's well that makes you around 80 you got a good age
